title: yencoding: encode_all_bytes_round_trip uses own code as oracle for dot/TAB line-start escapes
description: encode_all_bytes_round_trip calls encode() then decode() — both from the same crate — for the dot-at-line-start and TAB-at-line-start cases. This round-trip test proves self-consistency but not correctness. A systematic error in both halves would pass. There is no independent oracle (e.g. Python gen_fixtures.py output) for a payload containing a leading-dot or leading-TAB byte. Add a fixture from an external oracle (Python yenc library or manual computation per spec).
